svg.text: Junction — built outward from the crown, no junction-specific code
Bands are offsets of the union of the paved regions, so the wedge never reaches the ditch band. Smooth-min rounds the union corner into a fillet, which is what a junction physically has.
Peak curvature in this window: 8.78 /m with the blend-disc version → 2.84 /m here — equal to the road's own 3.28 /m, so nothing about the junction is sharper than plain road.
